# controls] with a counter on it" (The Thirteenth Doctor, Xolatoyac the
# Smiling Flood). parse_object refuses the "with a counter" qualifier (returns
# None), so the untap VERB lambda would yield no args and parse_atom would
# fall through to other verbs; build the each-subject here instead so
# reparse.py's untap_all branch can carry a has_counter flag the executor
# honors. Single base type + optional controller clause only; anything richer
# stays an honest miss. For every OTHER object phrase, defer to parse_object
# (and return None when it refuses) so parse_atom's first-verb-wins/continue-
# scan behavior is unchanged.
_UNTAP_COUNTER_RE = re.compile(
    r'^(each|all|every) (creature|permanent|artifact|enchantment|land)s?'
    r'(?: (you|an opponent) controls?)? with a counter on it$')
def _untap_args(rest):
    po = parse_object(rest)
    if po is not None:
        return {'obj': po, 'raw_obj': rest}
    m = _UNTAP_COUNTER_RE.match(rest.strip().rstrip('.'))
    if m:
        e = {'filter': m.group(2), 'has_counter': True}
        if m.group(3):
            e['controller'] = {'you': 'you', 'an opponent': 'opponent'}[m.group(3)]
        return {'obj': {'each': e}, 'raw_obj': rest}
    return None

def parse_atom(cl):
    """one clause -> (verb, typed|None) or (None, None) if verb unknown"""
    c = cl.strip().rstrip('.').strip()
    if not c: return ('empty', {})
    l = c.lower()
    # normalize leading "you" subject only — "it"/"~" are meaningful referents for pump/grant
    l = re.sub(r'^(you|~) ', '', l) if re.match(r'^(you|~) (draw|gain \d|gain x|lose|deal|create|mill|scry|surveil|may)', l) else l
    # task-2826 (verb_unmapped:? / until end of): a leading "until end of
    # turn, " duration prefix (e.g. "until end of turn, this creature gets
    # +2/+2 and gains lifelink") is printed FIRST but semantically modifies
    # the whole clause.  The pump/grant_eot/becomes_creature verb patterns
    # expect "until end of turn" as a trailing suffix, so move the prefix
    # to the end: "this creature gets +2/+2 and gains lifelink until end of
    # turn".  This preserves the printed semantics exactly — the duration
    # still applies to the same effect — while letting the existing regex
    # verbs fire without widening each one individually.
    _dur = None
    dm = re.match(r'^(until end of turn),\s+', l)
    if dm:
        _dur = dm.group(1)
        l = l[dm.end():]
    first = None
    for verb, rx, fn in VERBS:
        m = re.match(rx, l)
        if m:
            try:
                t = fn(m)
            except Exception:
                t = None
            if t is not None:
                return (verb, t)          # first verb whose args fully type wins
            if first is None:
                first = (verb, None)      # remember verb-recognized/args-raw fallback
    # If we stripped a leading "until end of turn, " and no verb fully
    # matched the bare clause, retry with " until end of turn" appended —
    # pump/grant_eot patterns require the suffix to anchor their regex.
    if _dur and first is None:
        l2 = l + ' until end of turn'
        for verb, rx, fn in VERBS:
            m2 = re.match(rx, l2)
            if m2:
                try:
                    t2 = fn(m2)
                except Exception:
                    t2 = None
                if t2 is not None:
                    return (verb, t2)
    return first or (None, None)

def _put_counters_referent_atom(va, ta, subj_est):
    """Half of an and-compound that is "put a/N <type> counter(s) on
    it/that creature/that permanent" — map_atom refuses referents on
    principle, but put_counters' antecedent IS resolvable: when the
    trigger established a non-self card subject (subj_est), the referent
    is that event subject (target_trigger_source, same wired/tested
    mechanism as the existing exact-clause _put_counters_referent path in
    the triggered loop). Returns the synthesized atom tuple, or None when
    the half isn't this shape (caller falls back to map_atom) or when
    subj_est is False — the not-subj_est case (the referent might be a
    PRIOR clause's chosen target rather than the source, e.g. Mark of
    Mutiny's "Gain control of target creature ... Put a +1/+1 counter on
    it"), so target_self would be a plausible-but-wrong guess; leave it an
    honest miss rather than force a fit. task-2368."""
    if va != 'put_counters' or not ta:
        return None
    if not subj_est:
        return None
    on = ta.get('on') or {}
    obj = on.get('object') if isinstance(on.get('object'), dict) else None
    if not obj or obj.get('filter') != 'referent':
        return None
    n = _amt(ta.get('amount'))
    if not (n and ta.get('type')):
        return None
    return ('put_counters',
            {'amount': n, 'counter_type': ta['type'], 'target_trigger_source': True},
            None)

def _for_each_bound_inner_atom(ch, group):
    """CH (already known to reference the loop element) -> a single Modes[0]
    atom bound via target_ref, or None. Only a card-element group can bind
    target_ref=="event_subject"; player-element groups (opponents/players)
    have no verified inner shape yet in this corpus (every 'that player'
    instance found needs per-iteration targeting instead, see module docs
    above) so they fall through to None (honest miss) rather than a guess."""
    ch = ch.strip().rstrip('.').lower() + '.'
    if group == 'permanents' and _FOR_EACH_TOKEN_COPY_RE.match(ch):
        return {'effect': 'token_copy', 'value': {'target_ref': 'event_subject'}}
    return None

def _map_for_each(link, ch, kind):
    """for_each round (2026-08-04): 'For each <phrase>, <effect>' -> a
    repeat_for_each atom (engine executes Modes[0] count times) when the
    inner effect does not reference the loop element, or (batch3, above) a
    for_each element-BINDING atom when it does. Returns the wrapped atom
    dict or None (honest miss)."""
    phrase = link.split(':', 1)[1] if ':' in link else ''
    cspec = parse_count_phrase(phrase) if phrase else None
    if cspec and not re.search(r'\b(it|that|them|its)\b', ch):
        verb, typed = O.parse_atom(ch)
        mapped = map_atom(verb, typed, kind=kind) if verb else None
        if mapped is not None and mapped[0] != 'SKIP' and mapped[0] in REGISTERED:
            eff, value, tgt = mapped
            if tgt is None and '_rider_gain_life' not in (value or {}) \
               and '_rider_keywords' not in (value or {}) \
               and '_rider_mass_damage' not in (value or {}):
                inner = {'effect': eff}
                if value:
                    inner['value'] = value
                return {'effect': 'repeat_for_each',
                        'value': {'count_spec': cspec}, 'modes': [[inner]]}
    gspec = _for_each_group_spec(phrase) if phrase else None
    if gspec is None:
        return None
    inner = _for_each_bound_inner_atom(ch, gspec['group'])
    if inner is None:
        return None
    return {'effect': 'for_each', 'value': gspec, 'modes': [[inner]]}


def _try_and_split(ch, kind=None, subj_est=False):
    """ch (a chunk whose full text has no recognized verb) -> [(eff,value,tgt), ...]
    of length 2, or None if it doesn't decompose safely."""
    if ' and ' not in ch:
        return None
    a, b = ch.split(' and ', 1)
    a, b = a.strip(), b.strip()
    if not a or not b:
        return None
    va, ta = O.parse_atom(a)
    if va is None:
        return None
    if B_HAS_SUBJ.match(b):
        vb, tb = O.parse_atom(b)
    elif _COUNTER_RIDER_RE.match(b):
        # task-2368 (verb_unmapped:put_counters): elided-verb counter rider
        # ("...and a +1/+1 counter on each Golem you control") — the "put"
        # verb is elided under conjunction. The only verb that puts counters
        # is "put", so re-attach it; the rider carries no subject, so do NOT
        # inherit the left clause's subject (the put-counters idiom is
        # imperative-self). Strict bare counter-on-object idiom only;
        # anything else keeps its own parse failure (honest miss).
        vb, tb = O.parse_atom('put ' + b)
    else:
        # elided subject ("...and loses 2 life") inherits the LEFT clause's
        # subject. If that subject is an explicit quantifier, reattach it
        # (never trust b's own you-default). Otherwise the left subject is
        # already "you"/imperative-self, which is what b's default means too.
        m = AND_SPLIT_SUBJ.match(a)
        vb, tb = O.parse_atom((m.group(1) + ' ' + b) if m else b)
    if vb is None:
        return None
    # task-2368 (verb_unmapped:put_counters): the put_counters referent half
    # ("put a +1/+1 counter on it/that creature") is resolvable via
    # target_trigger_source when the trigger established the antecedent —
    # synthesize it here so a clean no-target rider ("...and you gain 2
    # life", "...and create a Blood token") can still split, instead of the
    # whole compound staying a miss. Only subj_est; see helper docstring.
    ma = _put_counters_referent_atom(va, ta, subj_est)
    if ma is None:
        ma = map_atom(va, ta, kind=kind)
    mb = map_atom(vb, tb, kind=kind)
    if ma is None or mb is None:
        return None
    if ma[0] == 'SKIP' or mb[0] == 'SKIP':
        return None
    if ma[0] not in REGISTERED or mb[0] not in REGISTERED:
        return None
    if ma[2] is not None or mb[2] is not None:
        return None  # either half needs an explicit game target — shared
                     # Targets across the sequence makes that ambiguous; skip
    return [ma, mb]

def _atom_dict(eff, value, tgt, link=None, optional=False):
    atom = {'effect': eff}
    if value: atom['value'] = value
    if tgt: atom['target'] = tgt
    if link: atom['link'] = link
    if optional: atom['optional'] = True
    return atom

// ResolveTopOfStack resolves the top spell/ability on the stack (Rule 608)
func (gs *GameState) ResolveTopOfStack() error {
	if gs.Stack.IsEmpty() {
		return errors.New("stack is empty")
	}

	// Pop the top object
	topObj := gs.Stack.Pop()
	if topObj == nil {
		return errors.New("no object on stack")
	}

	// Handle abilities
	if topObj.IsAbility {
		// Intervening "if" clause (Rule 603.4): if the named condition
		// isn't satisfied at resolution, the ability does nothing.
		if topObj.IfCondition != "" && !gs.evalIfConditionWithSourceAndValue(topObj.IfCondition, topObj.Controller, topObj.Card, topObj.EffectValue) {
			gs.PrioritySystem.SetActivePlayer(gs.ActivePlayerIdx)
			gs.PrioritySystem.ResetPasses()
			gs.CheckStateBasedActions()
			return nil
		}

		// Optional "you may pay N {E}" trigger — pause and ask the
		// controller before executing.
		if topObj.MayPayEnergy > 0 {
			gs.PendingMayPay = &PendingMayPay{
				PlayerIdx:  topObj.Controller,
				Energy:     topObj.MayPayEnergy,
				SourceName: topObj.Card.Name,
				Stashed:    topObj,
			}
			return nil
		}

		// "Sacrifice unless you pay N {E}" trigger — pause and ask the
		// controller. Paying prevents the effect; declining executes it.
		if topObj.UnlessPayEnergy > 0 {
			gs.PendingMayPay = &PendingMayPay{
				PlayerIdx:   topObj.Controller,
				Energy:      topObj.UnlessPayEnergy,
				SourceName:  topObj.Card.Name,
				IsUnlessPay: true,
				Stashed:     topObj,
			}
			return nil
		}

		// Optional "you may pay N generic mana" trigger — the ordinary-mana
		// counterpart to MayPayEnergy above. Pause and ask the controller
		// before executing. MayPayManaCost (colored pips, e.g. {1}{U} for
		// Surgespanner, [VOCAB] #1065) also gates this branch since a
		// colored-only cost can leave MayPayMana at zero.
		if topObj.MayPayMana > 0 || topObj.MayPayManaCost != nil {
			gs.PendingMayPayMana = &PendingMayPayMana{
				PlayerIdx:  topObj.Controller,
				Mana:       topObj.MayPayMana,
				SourceName: topObj.Card.Name,
				Stashed:    topObj,
				ManaCost:   topObj.MayPayManaCost,
				Action:     topObj.MayPayAction,
			}
			return nil
		}

		// Extort (Rule 702.101) "you may pay {W/B}" trigger — pause and ask
		// the controller which color (or neither) to pay before executing.
		// Must be checked before the plain MayPayManaCost branch below since
		// IsExtort triggers carry no ManaCost at all (the color choice IS
		// the payment, resolved by ResolveExtortChoice itself).
		if topObj.IsExtort {
			gs.PendingExtort = &PendingExtort{
				PlayerIdx:  topObj.Controller,
				SourceName: topObj.Card.Name,
				Stashed:    topObj,
			}
			return nil
		}

		// Optional "you may pay N life" trigger — the life counterpart to
		// MayPayMana above. Pause and ask the controller before executing.
		// Unlike mana/energy, life is genuinely double-edged (declining
		// can be correct even if affordable), so this cannot reuse the
		// mana/energy pending machinery. [VOCAB] trigger-may-pay-life.
		if topObj.MayPayLife > 0 {
			gs.PendingMayPayLife = &PendingMayPayLife{
				PlayerIdx:  topObj.Controller,
				Life:       topObj.MayPayLife,
				SourceName: topObj.Card.Name,
				Stashed:    topObj,
			}
			return nil
		}

		// "Sacrifice unless you pay N generic mana" trigger — the mana
		// counterpart to UnlessPayEnergy above. Pause and ask the
		// controller. Paying prevents the effect; declining executes it
		// (typically sacrifice_self). Powers cumulative upkeep ([VOCAB]
		// #506, e.g. Wall of Shards): "pay {N}×age-counters or sacrifice".
		// UnlessPayManaCost is the colored-pip counterpart ([VOCAB] #1065).
		if topObj.UnlessPayMana > 0 || topObj.UnlessPayManaCost != nil {
			payerIdx := topObj.Controller
			if topObj.UnlessPayPlayerIdx != nil {
				payerIdx = *topObj.UnlessPayPlayerIdx
			}
			gs.PendingMayPayMana = &PendingMayPayMana{
				PlayerIdx:   payerIdx,
				Mana:        topObj.UnlessPayMana,
				SourceName:  topObj.Card.Name,
				IsUnlessPay: true,
				Stashed:     topObj,
				ManaCost:    topObj.UnlessPayManaCost,
			}
			return nil
		}

		// "Sacrifice unless ⟨action⟩" trigger — the non-resource counterpart
		// to UnlessPayEnergy/UnlessPayMana above. Pause and ask the
		// controller. Paying runs UnlessPayAction (e.g. "an opponent gains
		// N life") and prevents the stashed effect; declining executes the
		// stashed effect. Powers cumulative upkeep with a non-mana cost
		// ([VOCAB] #1295, Wall of Shards).
		if topObj.UnlessPayAction != nil {
			gs.PendingMayPay = &PendingMayPay{
				PlayerIdx:       topObj.Controller,
				SourceName:      topObj.Card.Name,
				IsUnlessPay:     true,
				UnlessPayAction: topObj.UnlessPayAction,
		}
	}
	return nil, errors.New("stack object not found")
}

// PushSpellWithTargets adds a spell with targets to the stack (Rule 601.2c)
func (s *Stack) PushSpellWithTargets(card *Card, controller int, targets []Target) {
	obj := &StackObject{
		Card:       card,
		Controller: controller,
		IsAbility:  false,
		Targets:    targets,
	}
	// Rule 702.60 — copy the printed/granted Split Second keyword onto the
	// stack object itself so GameState.checkSplitSecondLockout can detect it
	// by scanning live stack contents, the same way Storm and Uncounterable
	// are captured at push time (single choke point for every cast path:
	// gamestate_cast.go, cast_from_library.go, cast_from_exile.go).
	if card != nil && card.HasKeyword(SplitSecond) {
		obj.SplitSecond = true
	}
	s.Push(obj)
}

// keyword-cost shape: "Foretell {1}{B}" (Rule 702.129) — the record's
// keyword_cost/foretell must reach Card.ForetellCost, and the engine's
// two-step choreography must run off it: pay {2} to exile face down, then
// cast on a LATER turn for the foretell cost (game/foretell_exile.go
// ForetellCard/CastForetoldCard). Inert before 3c round 13.
func TestShape_KeywordCost_Foretell(t *testing.T) {
	fp, ftough := 2, 2
	def := &CardDefinition{
		Name: "Shape Foreteller", Type: "Creature", Types: []string{"Creature"},
		Power: &fp, Toughness: &ftough,
		Abilities: []AbilityDSL{
			{Type: "keyword_cost", Effect: "foretell",
				Value: map[string]interface{}{"black": 1, "generic": 1}},
		},
		Status: StatusManual,
	}
	card, err := def.ToGameCard(0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ToGameCard: %v", err)
	}
	if card.ForetellCost == nil {
		t.Fatal("foretell record not consumed: ForetellCost is nil")
	}
	if card.ForetellCost.Black != 1 || card.ForetellCost.Generic != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("wrong foretell cost: %+v", *card.ForetellCost)
	}

	gs := game.NewGame("P0", "P1", false) // non-debug: both costs must be paid
	gs.PhaseManager.CurrentPhase = game.Phase{Type: game.PhaseMain1, Step: game.StepMain}
	p := gs.Players[0]
	p.Hand.AddCard(card)

	// Step 1: pay the fixed {2} and exile face down (Rule 702.129a).
	p.ManaPool.Blue = 2
	if err := gs.ForetellCard(0, card.ID); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ForetellCard: %v", err)
	}
	if len(p.ForetoldCards) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 foretold card, got %d", len(p.ForetoldCards))
	}
	if p.Exile.Count() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("foretold card should sit in exile, count = %d", p.Exile.Count())
	}

	// Same-turn cast must be rejected (Rule 702.129b: "on a later turn").
	p.ManaPool.Black = 1
	p.ManaPool.Blue = 1
	if err := gs.CastForetoldCard(0, card.ID, 0, nil); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("casting a foretold card on the turn it was foretold should fail")
	}

	// Step 2: later turn, cast from exile for the foretell cost {1}{B}.
	gs.TurnCount++
	if err := gs.CastForetoldCard(0, card.ID, 0, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CastForetoldCard on a later turn: %v", err)
	}
	if len(p.ForetoldCards) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("foretold stash should be empty after cast, got %d", len(p.ForetoldCards))
	}
	if gs.Stack.Size() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("foretold cast should be on the stack, size = %d", gs.Stack.Size())
	}
}

package cards

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"

	"magic-backend/game"

func TestTargetPlayerDrawSpellRequiresAndUsesChosenPlayer(t *testing.T) {
	p := NewParser()
	def := &CardDefinition{
		Name: "Targeted Draw Test",
		Type: "Instant",
		Text: "Target player draws two cards.",
	}
	p.ParseCard(def)
	if len(def.ParseErrors) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ParseCard: unexpected errors: %v", def.ParseErrors)
	}

	spell, err := def.ToGameCard(0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ToGameCard: %v", err)
	}
	if spell.SpellEffect == nil {
		t.Fatal("ToGameCard: missing spell effect")
	}
	if spell.SpellEffect.Type != "draw" || spell.SpellEffect.Amount != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("ToGameCard: want draw 2, got %+v", spell.SpellEffect)
	}
	if spell.SpellEffect.SpellTargetType != game.TargetPlayer {
		t.Fatalf("ToGameCard: want player target, got %q", spell.SpellEffect.SpellTargetType)
	}

	gs := game.NewGame("P0", "P1", true)
	for playerIdx := range gs.Players {
		for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
			card := game.NewCard(
				fmt.Sprintf("Library Card P%d-%d", playerIdx, i),
				game.TypeLand,
				game.ManaCost{},
				playerIdx,
			)
			gs.Players[playerIdx].Library.AddCard(card)
		}
	}
	gs.Players[0].Hand.AddCard(spell)

	if err := gs.CastSpell(0, spell.ID); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("CastSpell without a player target succeeded")
	}
	if err := gs.CastSpellWithTargets(0, spell.ID, []game.Target{{
		Type:      game.TargetPlayer,
		PlayerIdx: 1,
	}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("CastSpellWithTargets: %v", err)
	}

	controllerHandBefore := gs.Players[0].Hand.Count()
	targetHandBefore := gs.Players[1].Hand.Count()
	controllerLibraryBefore := gs.Players[0].Library.Count()
	targetLibraryBefore := gs.Players[1].Library.Count()
	if err := gs.ResolveTopOfStack(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ResolveTopOfStack: %v", err)
	}

	if got := gs.Players[0].Hand.Count(); got != controllerHandBefore {
		t.Fatalf("controller hand changed from %d to %d", controllerHandBefore, got)
	}
	if got := gs.Players[1].Hand.Count(); got != targetHandBefore+2 {
		t.Fatalf("chosen player hand = %d, want %d", got, targetHandBefore+2)
	}
	if got := gs.Players[0].Library.Count(); got != controllerLibraryBefore {
		t.Fatalf("controller library changed from %d to %d", controllerLibraryBefore, got)
	}
	if got := gs.Players[1].Library.Count(); got != targetLibraryBefore-2 {
		t.Fatalf("chosen player library = %d, want %d", got, targetLibraryBefore-2)
	}
}
